title: 第29章 万毒窟的禁制
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
二长老厉寒离开火毒宗的当天傍晚，穆青把林尘叫到了炼丹室。

    她从铁柜里取出一张泛黄的羊皮地图，上面密密麻麻标注着万毒窟内部的地形。

    一条主甬道分出数十条岔路，每条岔路尽头都标着一个红圈，旁边用小字写着“废弃炼丹室”。

    地图边缘有几处被指甲反复划过的痕迹，那是穆青三年来每次翻看时留下的。

    “万毒窟的入口禁制只有内门弟子的令牌能打开。唐玉的令牌虽然已经注销，但令牌里的灵力印记还在——禁制只认灵力印记，不认人。你只需要把令牌贴在禁制核心上，注入灵力，禁制会自动识别唐玉的身份。”

    穆青的手指在地图上的入口位置点了一下。

    “入口在火毒宗后山废弃矿洞深处，执法堂的人平时不会巡逻到那里。但有一点——禁制被激活后会留下灵力残痕，残痕消退需要三天。如果在这三天内有人去检查禁制，就会发现有人进去过。”

    “厉寒什么时候回来。”

    “最快三天。他每季度去一次五柳城的炼丹师行会例会，来回路上各一天，会议本身只有一天。但他有时候会在五柳城多停留几天——上次他在五柳城待了五天，据说是去见了一个从万魔宗来的人。”

    穆青把地图推到林尘面前，又从袖子里摸出三根细长的引路香。

    “这是追踪香，点燃后会顺着念毒残留的方向飘烟。万毒窟里念毒浓度最高的地方就是唐铮当年去过的毒雾区，你跟着烟走就能找到。这香只对念毒有反应，对其他毒物无效——火毒宗的毒虫和毒兽大部分都用的是腐骨毒，不会干扰烟的走向。”

    “你留在入口望风？”

    “对。一个时辰。不管找没找到证据，一个时辰之内必须回来。超过一个时辰禁制的灵力残痕会加深，别人一眼就能看出来。”

    穆青把三根引路香放进林尘的背包里，又从药柜里翻出一小瓶清心草汁塞进去。

    “万毒窟里残留的念毒浓度是枯骨林毒瘴的十倍，虽然你的混沌圣体对念毒免疫，但清心草汁能防止毒雾进入眼睛——念毒对黏膜有腐蚀性，被毒雾喷到眼睛会暂时失明。”

    系统忽然弹出一道提示，面板悬浮在眼前。

    “检测到宿主即将进入高浓度念毒区域。混沌圣体对念毒完全免疫，但建议携带清心草汁用于眼部防护。温馨提示：唐铮在万毒窟中留下的暗记可能已被毒虫覆盖，灵纹感知可穿透表层覆盖物识别暗记位置。”

    林尘把清心草汁收好，背上背包。

    “唐铮在万毒窟里有没有留下什么标记？”

    “有。他失踪前跟我约定过一个暗记——一枚刻在石壁上的毒纹，只有火毒宗内门弟子才认识。他说如果自己没出来，就让我沿着暗记找他。但我这三年进不去万毒窟，厉寒把入口封了。”

    穆青走到炼丹炉旁边，从炉底取出一枚用银叶花汁浸过的铜片。

    “这上面刻的是唐铮的暗记图样。他在每个岔路口都会留一枚暗记，指向正确的方向。你沿着暗记走就能找到他当年去过的废弃炼丹室——信里提到的证据就藏在炼丹室地板下面的暗格里。”

    林尘接过铜片翻了个面，铜片上刻着一枚极细的毒纹，纹路呈逆时针螺旋状，和念毒的灵纹走向完全一致。

    “这枚毒纹本身就是念毒的灵纹结构图。唐铮用念毒灵纹做暗记——厉寒的人看到了也认不出来，因为他们对念毒的灵纹感知不够精细。只有学过毒纹结构的人才能辨认。”

    林尘把铜片收进怀里，抬头看向穆青。

    “苏荇让我问你，欠徐老头的那炉玄阶解毒丹什么时候还。她说你拿了那么多丹方和药材，跑路也不打声招呼，道个歉就原谅你。”

    穆青正在关铁柜的手顿了一下。

    “她现在在落雁谷过得怎么样。”

    “刚拿到玄阶丹师徽章。灵纹感知突破到了第三层，能主动引导灵纹融合方向。”

    “徐老头捡到你算是捡到宝了。苏荇学了三年才突破第三层，你才几天就帮她做到了——她的灵纹感知突破是你用混沌灵力引导的吧。”

    穆青把铁柜锁好，转过身靠在柜门上。

    “徐老头那炉玄阶解毒丹我确实欠了很久。等你从万毒窟出来，我把血煞爪毒素的解药配方配好，顺带把欠徐老头那炉丹的材料也备齐。不过现在先解决眼前的事——你准备什么时候进去。”

    “今晚。厉寒已经走了，执法堂的人今晚换岗，子时有一炷香的时间巡逻队不会经过后山矿洞。”

    “那就今晚。”

    穆青把炼丹室的门推开，外面天色已经擦黑，后山方向的火山岩在暮色中泛着暗红色的光。

    “唐铮欠我一顿酒，欠了三年。你要是能把他的信带出来，算我欠你一个人情。”

    林尘把苏荇那枚银质药鼎胸针在领口别好，背起背包，推门往后山方向走去。
content_en:
In the evening when the second elder Li Han left the Fire Poison Sect, Mu Qing called Lin Chen to the alchemy room.

    She took out a yellowed sheepskin map from the iron cabinet, with the terrain inside Ten Thousand Poison Cave densely marked on it.

    A main corridor branches off into dozens of forked roads, and at the end of each forked road is a red circle with the words "Abandoned Alchemy Room" written in small letters next to it.

    There are several marks on the edge of the map that have been scratched repeatedly by fingernails, which were left every time Mu Qing looked at them in the past three years.

    "The entrance ban of Ten Thousand Poison Cave can only be opened by the token of the inner disciple. Although Tang Yu's token has been canceled, the spiritual power imprint in the token is still there - the ban only recognizes the spiritual power imprint, not the person. You only need to stick the token on the core of the ban, inject spiritual power, and the ban will automatically identify Tang Yu's identity."

    Mu Qing's finger clicked on the entrance location on the map.

    "The entrance is deep in the abandoned mine in the back mountain of the Fire Poison Sect. People from the Law Enforcement Hall usually don't patrol there. But there is one thing - after the restriction is activated, it will leave traces of spiritual power, and it will take three days for the traces to fade. If someone checks the restriction within these three days, they will find that someone has gone in."

    "When will Li Han come back?"

    "Three days at the fastest. He goes to the alchemist's guild meeting in Wuliu City once a quarter. The journey back and forth takes one day each, and the meeting itself is only one day. But he sometimes stays in Wuliu City for a few more days - the last time he stayed in Wuliu City for five days, it is said that he went to meet someone from the Ten Thousand Demons Sect."

    Mu Qing pushed the map in front of Lin Chen and took out three slender incense sticks from his sleeves.

    "This is a tracking incense. When lit, the smoke will drift in the direction of the residual thought poison. The place with the highest concentration of thought poison in the Ten Thousand Poison Cave is the poisonous fog area that Tang Zheng visited. You can find it by following the smoke. This incense only reacts to thought poison and is ineffective against other poisons - most of the poisonous insects and poisonous beasts in the Fire Poison Sect use rotten bone poison, which will not interfere with the direction of the smoke."

    "Are you staying at the entrance to look out?"

    "Yes. One hour. Regardless of whether you find evidence or not, you must come back within one hour. The traces of spiritual power that are restricted for more than one hour will deepen, and others can see it at a glance."

    Mu Qing put three incense sticks into Lin Chen's backpack, and took out a small bottle of Qingxincao juice from the medicine cabinet and stuffed it in.

    "The concentration of mind poison remaining in the Cave of Ten Thousand Poisons is ten times that of the Dry Skeleton Forest Poison Miasma. Although your Chaos Holy Body is immune to the mind poison, the Qingxin Grass juice can prevent the poisonous mist from entering the eyes - the mind poison is corrosive to mucous membranes, and the poisonous mist spraying into the eyes will cause temporary blindness."

    The system suddenly popped up a prompt, and the panel floated in front of you.

    "It has been detected that the host is about to enter an area with a high concentration of mind poison. The Chaos Holy Body is completely immune to mind poison, but it is recommended to carry Qingxin grass juice for eye protection. Warm reminder: The secret mark left by Tang Zheng in the Ten Thousand Poison Cave may have been covered by poisonous insects. Spirit pattern perception can penetrate the surface covering to identify the location of the secret mark."

    Lin Chen put away the Qingxin grass juice and put on his backpack.

    "Did Tang Zheng leave any mark in Ten Thousand Poison Cave?"

    "Yes. Before he disappeared, he made an agreement with me about a secret mark - a poison pattern carved on the stone wall. Only the inner disciples of the Fire Poison Sect can recognize it. He said that if he didn't come out, he would let me follow the secret mark to find him. But I have not been able to enter the Ten Thousand Poison Cave for the past three years. Li Han has sealed the entrance."

    Mu Qing walked to the alchemy furnace and took out a copper piece soaked in silver leaf flower juice from the bottom of the furnace.

    "What is engraved on this is Tang Zheng's secret sign pattern. He will leave a secret sign at every fork in the road, pointing in the right direction. If you follow the secret sign, you can find the abandoned alchemy room he went to back then - the evidence mentioned in the letter is hidden in the secret compartment under the floor of the alchemy room."

    Lin Chen took the copper piece and turned it over. There was a very fine poison pattern engraved on the copper piece. The pattern was in a counterclockwise spiral shape, which was exactly the same as the spiritual pattern of thinking poison.

    "This poison pattern itself is the structural diagram of the poison pattern. Tang Zheng used the poison pattern as a secret mark - Li Han's people couldn't recognize it when they saw it, because their perception of the poison pattern is not refined enough. Only those who have learned the poison pattern structure can identify it."

    Lin Chen put the copper piece into his arms and looked up at Mu Qing.

    "Su Yun asked me to ask you when will you pay back the furnace Xuanjie detoxification pill that you owe Old Man Xu. She said that you took so many pills and medicinal materials and ran away without saying hello. I will forgive you if you apologize."

    Mu Qing's hand that was closing the iron cabinet paused.

    "How is she doing in Luoyan Valley now?"

    "I just got the Xuan-level Alchemist badge. My spiritual pattern perception has broken through to the third level, and I can actively guide the direction of spiritual pattern fusion."

    "Old man Xu found a treasure when he picked you up. It took Su Yun three years of learning to break through the third level, and you helped her do it in just a few days - her spiritual pattern perception breakthrough was guided by your chaotic spiritual power."

    Mu Qing locked the iron cabinet, turned around and leaned against the cabinet door.

    "I have indeed owed Old Man Xu that Furnace Level Antidote Pill for a long time. When you come out of the Cave of Ten Thousand Poisons, I will prepare the antidote formula for the Blood Evil Claw Toxin, and by the way, I will also prepare all the materials I owe Old Man Xu for that Furnace Pill. But let's settle the matter at hand first - when are you going to go in."

    "Tonight. Li Han has left. The people in the Law Enforcement Hall will change their guard tonight. The patrol team will not pass through the back mountain mine during the time when there is a stick of incense at midnight."

    "Tonight then."
title_en: Chapter 29 Restrictions in Ten Thousand Poison Cave
